title.narrative: Programa de Apoyo a las Reformas para el Crecimiento, Minerales Crticos e Inversin Productiva en Bolivia
Support Program for Reforms to Foster Growth, Critical Minerals and Productive Investment in Bolivia

description.narrative: El objetivo general de desarrollo es contribuir al crecimiento econmico sostenible de Bolivia mediante un marco propicio para la inversin privada, la diversificacin productiva y el fortalecimiento institucional. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) mejorar el marco regulatorio y operativo para impulsar la inversin privada, con nfasis en sectores estratgicos;(ii) fortalecer el ecosistema empresarial para promover la diversificacin productiva y exportadora; y(iii) consolidar la capacidad institucional para la gestin de polticas proinversin y procompetitividad.

The overall development objective is to contribute to Bolivia's sustainable economic growth by fostering an enabling environment for private investment, productive diversification, and institutional strengthening. The specific objectives are to: (i) improve the regulatory and operational framework to stimulate private investment, with an emphasis on strategic sectors; (ii) strengthen the business ecosystem to promote productive and export diversification; and (iii) consolidate institutional capacity for the design and management of pro-investment and pro-competitiveness policies.
